claim: Original SHA-verified 440-resource fpw_* panel contains 65 textual _0/_1/_2 sibling families, yielding exactly 79 source payload pair comparisons (65 _0/_1, seven _0/_2, seven _1/_2). Within each pair the original embedded payload lengths and bytes+48..+63 match exactly, yet every pair differs at other source byte positions. Complete window-based comparisons find 62 pairs differing at bytes+0..47 (128 changed byte positions across all pairs), zero pairs at +48..63 (zero changes), four pairs at +64..75 (seven changes), and 79 pairs at +76 onward (7836 changes). Total pairwise changed-byte positions 7971, minimum14 and maximum417 in a pair. A complete ordered 79-pair offset-difference index has SHA256 61ba2c2012dc91eeffe4a178ca0e4c2187a392f51c98d8cf9ce1aaf533364f81. This is a comparison of original source bytes and suffix filenames only, not identification of animation direction, motion, timing, source load execution or actor pose.
